name: Service Principal Lifecycle Abuse
description: Service principals are the non-human identities apps use. Creating one, adding an owner, or deleting one you used as a backdoor are all ways to persist without a person logging in. They do not get tired, they do not use MFA by default, and they are easy to forget in a review. Unexpected service-principal create or owner add, especially with Graph permissions, is a backdoor until an app owner claims it.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
